decisionsTitle: «Tema v1» and «Tema v2» instead of «Aspectul nou», and the calendar's selectors in the family of its other controls
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-13:** «Mai e o chestie de design legat de aspectul nou (care ar trebui să se numească „temă” btw, și să avem tema v1 și tema v2), primele 2 selectoare arată diferit».

**Decision (amending §708, §720, §734).**

1. **The name.** The setting the club read as «Aspectul nou» is now «Tema», one choice of two in «Setări» → «Aspect»: **«Tema v1»** (EN "Theme v1"), the site as it has been, and **«Tema v2»** ("Theme v2"), the facelift. It is the same two-radio form as before — the same field `look`, the same stored value (`off` | `on`), the same `data-look="2026"` scope, no migration, no change to `src/theme/look.ts`'s selectors — with new words everywhere the club or a visitor reads them: the card's title and legend («Alege tema»), the save button («Salvează tema»), the confirmation, the saved alert, the design page's «Mostre» and its comparison, the cover photo's help, and `docs/REDESIGN.md` and `docs/VIBECODING.md` (which say once that Tema v2 was «Aspectul nou» until 2026-10-13). The old names in `DECISIONS.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` and `SPECS.md` stay as they were written; identifiers and code comments keep the old name. «Tema» in the sense of light and dark is now «varianta deschisă» / «varianta întunecată» where it stood beside the look's name, so the two meanings are not read as one.

2. **The calendar's two selectors under Tema v2.** «Luna» and «Anul» were outlined MUI selects with floating legends beside the soft segmented «Lună | An» / «Calendar | Listă» and «Azi». Under the look only (`UNDER_LOOK`, in `CalendarPicker.tsx`) they are now of one family with them: the same 44-pixel height (from `sm` too, where they were 34), the same 12-pixel radius ("Azi" moved from 10 to 12), the `divider` border on the paper surface, `primary.main` on hover and a 2-pixel `primary.main` border on keyboard focus (the only focus indicator a native select has), the caret in the text's colour, and no floating legend — the label stays the select's accessible name, visually hidden, and the notch it cut in the outline is gone. Still the same island and `router.push`, so it works as before; at 320 pixels the period row is one 44-pixel row and the first week stays above the fold (§569). No colour literal: `background.paper`, `divider`, `primary.main` and `text.primary` only. With Tema v1 the head is drawn exactly as before.

**Refused:** swapping the select's caret glyph for a chevron (it would change Tema v1's pixels, and the two controls share one component); a new select component (the existing one is styled under the look); renaming the stored value or the `data-look` scope (a migration and a flip for nothing the visitor sees).
changelogLine: - **«Tema v1» and «Tema v2»** — the setting «Aspectul nou» is now the choice «Tema» (Tema v1: the site as it has been; Tema v2: the facelift), and under Tema v2 the calendar's «Luna» and «Anul» selectors are drawn like the segmented controls and «Azi» beside them. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: The setting that switches the facelift is drawn as the choice «Tema» with two radios, «Tema v1» and «Tema v2» ("Theme v1", "Theme v2"), the same field and stored value as before, and neither catalogue reads «Aspectul nou» or "the new look" (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the calendar with «Tema v2» on, at 1280 and at 320 pixels the «Luna» and «Anul» selectors are as high as the segmented group beside them (at least 44 pixels), have its radius, show no floating label while «Luna» and «Anul» stay their accessible names, and at 320 pixels the period row stays one row; with «Tema v1» the head is today's, its labels drawn (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: Tema v1 / Tema v2; the calendar's selectors match
